aboutDescription: With one year of experience in web and mobile development, I am expanding my skills towards a 360° vision. I am joining the Application Designer-Developer (CDA) program to master Full-Stack architecture and the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence. I am looking for a work-study program to contribute to large-scale projects, from the user interface to the deployment of models.
softwareDeveloperDescription:
• Full-Stack work-study program within an Agile (Scrum) team of 6
 developers, ensuring the maintenance and evolution of internal tools.

• Graphical redesign of an internal HR management application (DigiRH) with Tailwind CSS, adding a CSV export system for leave requests and meal vouchers, improving internal user satisfaction (ANGULAR/SYMFONY).

• Technical lead for the subsidized DigiLearnIA project
: I managed the integration of an AI conversational agent into an LMS platform (PYTHON/SYMFONY), which included gathering and formalizing user requirements, contributing to the validation and success of the project's first phase.

• Conducted technological watch on data tools and practices (analysis, visualization, AI),
 leading to technical architecture proposals for product evolution.
agentTriDescription:
• Optimized workflow by training and supervising a team of 6
collaborators, reducing the sorting error rate by 15%.
hospitalDescription:
• Rigorous application of radiology protocols, contributing to zero
incidents during the period.
project1Description: Task management application with Kanban system to organize and prioritize your projects. Features drag & drop functionality to move tasks between columns, with an intuitive and responsive interface.
project2Description: Pomodoro timer to optimize your productivity by dividing work into 25-minute intervals. Includes session statistics, sound notifications, and customizable work and break durations.
project3Description: Tool to save, organize, and quickly retrieve your reusable code snippets. Supports multiple programming languages with syntax highlighting and tag system for efficient searching.
project4Description: HabitWave is a web application for building habits, managing tasks, and improving productivity. With an intuitive interface, it allows you to track your progress, view a dynamic calendar, and customize reminders.
project5Description: An institutional website project for a psychologist named Flavia Araujo. The project has a responsive design and dynamic information, being a redesign of the professional's old site.
project6Description: A full-stack web project of a real-time chat application, with a Node.js and Express server and a React.js frontend.
